column1: # The names of the transparency plane, and what becomes of each when the lineage and stream model moves to
# Signed Statements, Transparency Services and Receipts (RFC 9943, RFC 9942). One row for each protocol-visible name
# of the registry, the payload tables and the Parts that carries one of the plane's words.
# fate: rename (new_name takes its place, with no alias), retire (a row or member of that name is refused by name),
#       keep (the name stands), new (a name this model adds), open (not yet decided; the note says what decides it).
# Not in scope: SQL names, a component's own verbs and identifiers, and the atoms of the formal models.
# Checked by tools/check_scitt_names.py. Nothing is renamed by this table: it is the plan every surface follows at once.

column5: sense
column6: note

column5: a witness's cosignature on a tree head
column6: A Receipt replaces it (RFC 9943): the service registers the head in its own log and answers with a Receipt. A row of the family is refused at the door by name.

column5: the ceremony by which a node agreed to witness a lineage
column6: A lineage names its transparency services in its charter, and a service consents by issuing Receipts. A row of the family is refused at the door by name.

column5: a subscriber's acknowledgement of a chunk
column6: A name change and nothing else. Receipt is kept for the Receipt of RFC 9943.

column5: an inclusion proof as a row
column6: An inclusion proof rides inside a Receipt. No component produces the row or has a door for it. A row of the family is refused at the door by name.

column5: a consistency proof as a row
column6: A consistency proof is submission material beside a head (RFC 9942 label 396). No component produces the row or has a door for it. A row of the family is refused at the door by name.

column5: the collection of members' signatures for a counted row
column6: Not the witnessing sense. A counted row short of its count is held as its own voices (CC 3.3.4). A row of the family is refused at the door by name.

column5: an affected party's singular testimony
column6: Not the witnessing sense.

column5: the diversity of a Contribution's reviewers
column6: Not the witnessing sense.

column5: the services a lineage's heads are registered with
column6: Identity references, composite keys only. Changes the bytes of a charter that carries it; the genesis charter carries none.

column5: how many of the named services must issue a Receipt
column6: Exactly the strict majority of the named services.
